    Extract predictions

    extract_predictions.Rd

    Help function to extract requested predictions from an object returned by pred_crossbasis().

    extract_predictions(
  x,
  slice_x = NULL,
  slice_y = NULL,
  slice_lag = NULL,
  slice_by = NULL,
  ptype = "allfit"
)

    Arguments

    x

    An object returned by pred_crossbasis().

    slice_x

    Exposure values of the first exposure variable at which to extract predictions. Integer or numeric vector.

    slice_y

    Exposure values of the second exposure variable at which to extract predictions (bivariate exposures only). Integer or numeric vector.

    slice_lag

    Lag value(s) at which to extract predictions. Integer or numeric vector.

    slice_by

    Optional argument to specify the levels of the by-variable at which to extract predictions. One value or multiple values supplied through a vector.

    ptype

    Character string specifying the type of prediction. One of:

    "matfit"

    Predictions for specified combinations of exposure and lag variables.

    "matRRfit"

    Predictions for exponentiated associations for specified combinations of exposure and lag variables.

    "allfit"

    Predictions for overall cumulative associations, default value.

    "allRRfit"

    Predictions for exponentiated associations for overall cumulative risks.

    Value

    A dataframe containing the requested exposures (and lags), predicted value, lower and upper bounds on the credible intervals (if requested in predictions), exceedance probabilities (if requested in predictions), and levels of the by-variable (if applicable).

    Examples

    data(barcelona_temp)
data(shapefile_bcn)

# Examples of applications

dataset <- barcelona_temp |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    dow = weekdays(date),
    year = lubridate::year(date),
    month = lubridate::month(date)
  )

group <- factor(paste0(dataset$District, "-", dataset$year))


### Example 1: Penalized and common DLNM

# Create the (unpenalized) crossbasis

knots_max <- quantile(dataset$Tmax, probs = c(0.10,0.50,0.90))
knots_lag <- dlnm::logknots(0:14, nk = 2)

basis.max_unpen <- dlnm::crossbasis(
    dataset$Tmax,
    argvar=list(fun = "ns", knots = knots_max),
    arglag=list(fun="ns", knots = knots_lag),
    lag=14,
    group=group
)

# Fit model
model_max_conf <- dlnmLPS(
    dtot ~ 1 + factor(dow) +
    sm(month, arg = list(type = "ns", df = 3)) +
    sm(year, arg = list(type = "rw1")) +
    sm(depriv, arg = list(type = "ns", df = 3)) +
    sm(basis.max_unpen, by = depriv,
            arg.by = list(type = "ns", df = 3)) +
    sm(District, arg = list(type = "Leroux", map = shapefile_bcn)),
    data = dataset,
    offset = log(pop),
    model.comparison = list(DIC = TRUE),
    family = "Poisson")

# Make predictions
pred_conf_max <- pred_crossbasis(
    basis.max_unpen,
    model_max_conf,
    at_x = 22:30,
    cen = 25,
    lag = c(0,14),
    CI = TRUE,
    by = quantile(dataset$depriv,probs= c(0.10, 0.90))
)

# Extract overall RR for 28 and 30 degrees Celsius for both deprivation indices
extract_predictions(
    pred_conf_max,
    slice_x = c(28,30),
    ptype = "allRRfit"
)
#>    x      fit    lower    upper                 by
#> 1 28 1.236969 1.148188 1.332615 -0.929699483475094
#> 2 30 1.435580 1.158489 1.778947 -0.929699483475094
#> 3 28 1.217482 1.132780 1.308517   1.21474771640633
#> 4 30 1.620977 1.462298 1.796875   1.21474771640633

# Extract lag-specific RR for 28 and 30 degrees Celsius, lag 0 and 8 and
# for 10% deprivation percentile
extract_predictions(
    pred_conf_max,
    slice_x = c(28,30),
    slice_lag = c(0,8),
    slice_by = quantile(dataset$depriv,probs= c(0.10)),
    ptype = "matRRfit"
)
#>    x lag       fit     lower    upper                 by
#> 1 28   0 1.0840473 1.0422849 1.127483 -0.929699483475094
#> 2 30   0 1.2925594 1.1909441 1.402845 -0.929699483475094
#> 3 28   8 1.0175714 1.0054077 1.029882 -0.929699483475094
#> 4 30   8 0.9985843 0.9716919 1.026221 -0.929699483475094
